payload.reason: The evidence discusses the capabilities of models in zero-shot settings, particularly in reading comprehension tasks, and indicates what the model learns in such scenarios.

claims.text: In a zero-shot setting, the model learns to perform reading comprehension tasks without needing translated source data, which can degrade performance.
The model leverages pre-trained language representations to enable cross-lingual understanding and perform tasks in languages for which it has not been specifically trained.
